Supply and Delivery#000.src: Well? Did you buy the supply crate yet?
Supply and Delivery#000.speaker:
Ope
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Supply and Delivery#001.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. It's not that hard!
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: Tek yapman gereken Ticaret Pazarı'na gidip erzak sandığını benim için satın almak. O kadar da zor değil!
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker:
Ope
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

similar.text: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?

Supply and Delivery#002.src: You bought the crate! Good, good. You still need to pick it up from the Trade Market, though!
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: Sandığı almışsın! Güzel, güzel. Ama yine de Ticaret Pazarı'ndan teslim alman lazım!
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker:
Ope
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Supply and Delivery#004.src: "They have taken the forest. The last barrier between them and {p} is us."
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: "Ormanı ele geçirdiler. Onlarla {p} arasındaki son engel biziz."

Supply and Delivery#005.src: "We must fortify. Put those fires out!"

Supply and Delivery#006.src: "If we lose tree cover, we lose the war."

Supply and Delivery#008.src: Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: Hey! Şey, ben... fark etmeden duramadım da. Hâlâ buradasın. Sandıkla. Onu {p} tarafına götürmen gerekiyordu, hatırladın mı?

Supply and Delivery#009.src: Oh, you're one of those {p} soldiers. If I can give some advice?
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: Aa, sen şu {p} askerlerinden birisin. Bir tavsiye verebilir miyim?

Supply and Delivery#010.src: You should pick up some items from the Accessory Merchant in town! They might really help you out.
Supply and Delivery#010.dst: Kasabadaki Aksesuar Tüccarı'ndan birkaç eşya almalısın! Sana gerçekten çok yardımı dokunabilir.

Supply and Delivery#011.src: Normally you can only find accessories in rare cave loot, so a merchant like ours is actually a rarity.
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: Aksesuarlar normalde sadece nadir mağara ganimetlerinde bulunur, yani bizimki gibi bir tüccar aslında az bulunur bir nimet.

Supply and Delivery#012.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: Ne? Bana öyle bakma! İkimizin de kârlı çıktığı gayet adil bir alışverişti. Ben bitkiyi aldım, sen de... şey. Tecrübe kazandın?
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: Yani ya erzakı {p} tarafına sen götürürsün... ya da ikimiz birlikte kaçıp yeni bir hayata başlarız ve yaptıklarımızın sonuçlarından kurtuluruz!
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: Selam! {p} tarafına gidecek araba mı arıyorsun? Söylemesi kötü ama araba bozuldu.

Supply and Delivery#015.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Tamiri uzun sürmez bence, ama şimdilik yolu kendin gitmen gerekecek.

Supply and Delivery#016.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: Bu hızlı yolculuğu kullanmak için Tedarik ve Teslimat görevini tamamlaman gerekir.

Supply and Delivery#017.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: Umarım bu zümrütler yeterli olur. Ayrıca... bozuk arabalarımızdan birini yakın zamanda tamir ettik, {p} tarafına gidip geliyor.
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#019.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: Of, be... Şimdi ne yapacağım ben...
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: A-a! M-merhaba asker! Vay, ne tesadüf, ikimiz de buradayız... {p} bölgesinde... bugün...
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Bak, tamam, anlıyorum! Ama nasıl olsa sana borcumu ödeyemem. Muhtar beni buraya köy için bir sandık erzak almaya gönderdi.
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: Sorun şu ki... Param çoktan bitti, şey, alakasız alışverişlere. Param olsa bile erzak sandığını zaten alamazdım...
Supply and Delivery#022.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: Pazarı işleten şu ikisi, dünyadaki bütün büyülü toz stokunu satın almaya çalıştım diye beni pazardan ömür boyu menettiler.
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: Bak, büyük piyasa hamleleri yapıyorsam benim suçum değil. Ben sadece, bilirsin, buradaki herkesten daha zekiyim!
Supply and Delivery#024.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#025.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: ... Demek istediğim. Şu an yardımına gerçekten ihtiyacım var! B-bu sefer borcumu ödeyeceğime söz veriyorum.
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#026.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: Tek yapman gereken Ticaret Pazarı'na gidip erzak sandığını benim için satın almak. Lütfen?
Supply and Delivery#026.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#027.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: ... Ne? Seni de mi pazardan menettiler?! Harika, valla. Şimdi ne yapacağız?
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#028.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: Peki, işe katabileceğimiz başka arkadaşın var mı? Şu öbür asker vardı ya... Adı... Tim'di. Ya da öyle bir şey.
Supply and Delivery#028.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#029.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: Bak, tamam, anladım, insanların adını hatırlamayan bir hıyarım! Ondan bizim için erzakı almasını isteyemez misin?? Son umudumuz o... galiba.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#030.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Ticaret Pazarı'ndan erzak sandığını satın al.

Supply and Delivery#031.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Hey, aferin! Şimdi erzak sandığını teslim alman gerekecek.
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#032.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda Tasim'i bul ve erzak sandığını senin için almaya ikna et.

Supply and Delivery#033.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#033.dst: Aa, selam {u}! Takılmaya mı geldin? Yoksa... yüzündeki o ifade başka bir şey için geldiğini söylüyor.
Supply and Delivery#033.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#034.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: [{~}] Benim için Ticaret Pazarı'ndan bir şey alabilir misin?

Supply and Delivery#035.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: Sanırım... alabilirim? Kendin alamamanın bir sebebi var mı?
Supply and Delivery#035.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#036.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: ...Pazardan men mi edildin? Bunu nasıl başardın? {p} bölgesine geleli o kadar olmadı bile!
Supply and Delivery#036.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#037.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: Sen- ne!? Boş ver, aslında bilmek istemiyorum. Hadi, yolu göster. Neye ihtiyacın varsa... alırım.
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#038.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: ...Ha. Bu her şeyi açıklıyor. Ama, kendin alamamanın bir sebebi var mı?
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#039.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: Sen- ne!? Boş ver, aslında bilmek istemiyorum. Hadi, yolu göster. Ope'nin neye ihtiyacı varsa alırım.
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#040.src: Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#040.dst: Aa, merhaba . Sen de mi eğitime geldin? Yoksa... yüzündeki o ifade başka bir şey için geldiğini söylüyor.
Supply and Delivery#040.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#041.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#042.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: Peki. Yani sadece bir erzak sandığı alıyorum...
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#043.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: İşte burada. Neyin peşindeysen... bol şans.
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: Erzak sandığıyla [{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumundaki Ope'nin yanına dön

Supply and Delivery#045.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#045.dst: Mükemmel! Şimdi çabuk buraya gel, o ikisi benimle iş yaptığını fark etmeden!
Supply and Delivery#045.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#046.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: Eşyayı aldın mı? Güzel. Güzel, güzel, güzel.
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#047.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: Tamam! Şimdi ikinci adıma geçiyoruz. Yani, bak, bu paketin hâlâ {p} tarafına ulaşması lazım...
Supply and Delivery#047.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: Ve. Şey. Sandığı tutan sensin, ben değil! Yani... anlarsın!
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: Harika! Yolu artık biliyorsundur, eminim! Benim, ıı, ayağına dolaşmama gerek yok!
Supply and Delivery#049.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: Sen şu erzakı {p} tarafına götür, ve. Şey. Her şey yoluna girer.
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: Şey, bak. Bunu hiç yapmak istemiyorum. Yapmayacağım da!
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#053.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: ...olmaz mı? Olmaz. Tamam. Denemeye değerdi. Neyse, yolu artık biliyorsun! Benim, ıı, ayağına dolaşmama gerek yok! Hı hı...
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#054.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: Eşyayı senin için aldı mı? Güzel. Güzel, güzel, güzel. Tamam! Bu... beklediğimden zor oldu.
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#055.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Erzak sandığını [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] konumunda, {p} bölgesindeki Muhtar Alvin'e götür.

Supply and Delivery#056.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#056.dst: Ah, merhaba! Bugün senin için ne yapabilirim?
Supply and Delivery#056.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#057.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: Ah... Demek öyle. Onu almaya Ope'yi gönderdiğimi sanıyordum...
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#058.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: Yine onun dalavereleri herhalde. Onunla iki kez uğraşmak zorunda kaldığın için üzgünüm.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#059.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: Köye döndüğünde onunla bir konuşmam gerekecek... Ah, ama tabii ki zahmetinin karşılığını ödemeliyim.
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#060.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: İstediğin zaman çekinmeden kullanabilirsin! Bizim için yaptığın her şeye teşekkür olarak.
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#061.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: O iyi bir adam, gerçekten. Buna tüm kalbimle inanıyorum. Ama sen aynı şekilde düşünmüyorsan sorun değil. İstemiyorsan seni onunla muhatap olmaya zorlamam.
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: Aman... Eski muhtar görevi bıraktığında bu makama geçeli on beş yıl olmuştur herhalde.
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#063.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#063.dst: İyi kalpli bir adamdı, kasaba halkını hep gözetirdi. Ama emekli olduğunda küçük kasabamızda içinin içine sığmadığı belliydi.
Supply and Delivery#063.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#064.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#064.dst: Görevi bana devreder devretmez hemen {p} tarafına gidip ordularına yazıldı! Duyduğuma göre bugünlerde asker yetiştiriyormuş.
Supply and Delivery#064.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#065.src: Ah, but I've tried to live up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#065.dst: Ah, ama ben de onun mirasına layık olmaya çalıştım. Muhtarlığım boyunca iyi iş çıkardığımı düşünmek hoşuma gidiyor!
Supply and Delivery#065.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#066.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#066.dst: Buradan geçmek için güzel bir gün! Umarım burada keyifli vakit geçirirsin.
Supply and Delivery#066.speaker: Mayor Alvin
